name: Italian Constitutional Court, judgment no. 58/2018 – 2015 Ilva decree (worker)
description: Question of constitutional legitimacy raised by the Judge for Preliminary Investigations (GIP) of Taranto concerning Article 3 of Decree-Law no. 92/2015, which had allowed the blast furnace AFO2 of Ilva to resume operations immediately after the fatal accident of a worker, while under judicial seizure, on the basis of a mere generic plan. Violation of Articles 2, 3, 4, 32, 35, 41 and 112 of the Constitution was alleged.
outcome: Provision declared unconstitutional. Applying the criteria of judgment no. 85/2013, the Court held that, in the case at hand, the legislature had “privileged solely the requirements of economic initiative”, sacrificing the life and health of workers. An important signal: the balancing between rights must always be verified on the merits and cannot compress the essential core of the right to life and health.
